title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a pair address reads the package it names: its envelope is that package's, and an App pair two of whose modules hold the name is refused naming both (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBdS96DD1Rta7hrLt6bkwBb)_
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXYPmTrQ4KGuKWzNh7

Fixes #32501

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=APP.custom` and its `/layers`, on both transports, when two enabled modules of the App hold the name, are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both modules where they served the first registered module's item; `/layers` at an App pair that holds a stored row of a name two of its modules ship, when one of those modules is the first registered package that ships the name, is refused the same way where it reported that module's body as the code layer. The other moved answers keep their status and name the package the address reads in place of the first registered holder: the envelope (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance`) of `?package=BASE.custom` and of a stored row read at an exact address. Three widen from 404 to 200, on the plain read and `/layers`: the pair of an enabled base and an App pair one of whose two module holders is disabled, when the disabled holder registered first, and a row of a package that ships nothing beside a disabled shipper.
Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which package an exact read's answer names, and when it refuses.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no read at a customization pair address of a name two packages hold; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the before → after list in the changeset.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按配对地址（`?package=基包.custom`）读取元数据时，返回体的 `_packageId` / `_packageVersion` / `_provenance` 现在取自地址实际读的那个包，不再取最先注册的持有者；App 的两个模块都持有同名项时，App 配对地址（含 `/layers`）返回 409 点名两个模块，不再挑先注册的那个。
- 为什么：专题红线 2（歧义要报告、不许猜）。以前两个包持有同名项时，后注册那个包的配对地址答自己的内容却标成先注册包的；先注册的包被停用时，启用包的配对地址甚至答 404。
- 风险与回滚：第一方 0 处（要求两个命名空间持有同名项）。收窄只发生在 App 两个模块同持一名的配对地址；三处 404 → 200 是放宽。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts` 的 `exactAddressArtifact`；`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `readMetaItem` 信封查找；`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 的 `exactQualifierItem` 早返回那一行（两个基包时落到点名拒绝）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-legacy-pair-served.test.ts -t 32501`，预期 9 例全过（main 上 8 例红，剩下那例是注册顺序对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Branch head `1d8ea4ad7`. It is `main` 2f80f2897 plus this card: the blocker's landed head and `main` are merged in (merge section below), and the diff against `main` is 9 files, +447 / −22.

Measured on `main` 2f80f2897 against this head, per answer (the dispatcher over the `SchemaRegistry` composition the transport pins drive, and the real ObjectQL engine with an SQL store for stored rows; the REST pins answer the same on the other transport):

| # | state | door | FROM (`main` 2f80f2897) | TO (this head) | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| L2 | two enabled modules M1, M2 of App P hold NAME, either order (`SchemaRegistry` composition) | `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=P.custom` and its `/layers` | 200, the first registered module's item | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming M1 and M2 | narrowing |
| L2r | App pair `P.custom` holds a stored row; M1, M2 ship NAME, a module is the first registered shipper, no other package ships it (real engine) | `/layers?package=P.custom` | 200, that module's body as `code` | 409 naming M1 and M2 | narrowing |
| L2r′ | the same, another package registered ahead of the modules | `/layers?package=P.custom` | 409 (already: #32497 judges the code layer through `exactQualifierItem`) | 409 | none |
| L1 | A and B enabled hold NAME, B registered first | `?package=A.custom` | 200 A's body under B's `_packageId` | 200 A's body under A's | moved answer |
| L1′ | the same | `/layers?package=A.custom` | 200 A's code layer (already, #32497) | the same | none |
| L1d | B disabled and registered first | `?package=A.custom` and its `/layers` | 404 | 200 A's item | widening |
| L2d | M2 disabled and registered first | `?package=P.custom` and its `/layers` | 404 | 200 M1's item | widening |
| R1 | A's pair override row at `A.custom`, B registered first | `?package=A.custom` | the row under B's `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance` | under A's | moved answer |
| R2 | a row bound only to G, which ships nothing; either shipper order | `?package=G` | the row under the first registered shipper's envelope (`_provenance: package`) | its own stamp (`_packageId: G`), no artifact envelope | moved answer |
| R2′ | the same | `/layers?package=G` | `code: null` (already) | the same | none |
| R3 | the row bound to G, its only shipper disabled | `?package=G` and its `/layers` | 404 (withheld by the disabled shipper's grafted stamp) | 200, the row under its own stamp | widening |
| R4 | the App pair's own row, two modules ship NAME, any order | `?package=P.custom` | the row under the first registered shipper's envelope | its own stamp (`P.custom`) | moved answer |

**The fix** (three source hunks, unchanged since the card's development round):

1. **F1, the strict envelope** (`protocol-package-bindings.ts` `exactAddressArtifact`, called from `readMetaItem`). At an admitted exact address the artifact envelope is looked up at the one package the address reads (the named package when it holds the name, else its one admitted base) and kept only when it is that package's own (`_packageId` equal to it). Two admitted bases, or none, leave the body its own stamp. Before, the lookup asked at the pair id, which ships nothing, so `getArtifactItem`'s any-composite tier answered the first registered package that ships the name.
2. **F2, two admitted bases** (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` `exactQualifierItem`, one line). An item of one of TWO admitted bases (two modules of one App sharing its pair) no longer returns early; it falls through to the refusal naming both. The plain read and `/layers` share this judge.
3. **F3 is no longer this card's.** The round-1 hunk that sent the `/layers` code layer through `exactQualifierItem` is on `main` already: #32497 carries the same call (its #32407 lines), so the merge took `main`'s file and this card no longer edits `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`.

Composition note (seat ruling 6817992172): L2 without a stored row is already 409 on the real engine on `main`; it reproduces on the bare `SchemaRegistry` composition the transport pins use (`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`). The stored-row pins (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-legacy-pair-served.test.ts`) drive the real engine and SQL store.

## Merge with main after #32497

#32497 landed squashed as `0763bf6ec`. Its tree delta is byte-identical to `776474e8b..28b37fbb7` (the blocker's landed head): same 53 files, same `git patch-id --stable`. So the branch takes that head first and `main` second, both as merges, no rebase:

- `6e575e3a` merges `28b37fbb7`. Conflicts, each resolved to the blocker's side for what #32497 owns: `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` (taken whole; see F3), and the REST and runtime test files where both sides appended a top-level `describe` at the same spot (both kept, the blocker's first).
- `040e2d62` merges `main` 2f80f2897. The only conflicts were three hunks where this card edits lines #32497 added (the #32501 location 1 pin flips below); each is the branch's side, which is `main`'s text plus the flip.
- `git show --remerge-diff` of each merge touches only this card's files: `6e575e3a` → `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, the REST and runtime `meta-qualified-item-*` tests; `040e2d62` → `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` and the same two tests.
- `1d8ea4ad` re-measures on `main` 2f80f2897: the changeset drops the two `/layers` moves #32497 already made (the base's code layer at `?package=BASE.custom`, `code: null` at a package that ships nothing) and narrows the App-pair-row `/layers` claim to the module-first shape; the three widening pins assert `/layers` beside the plain read; the stored-row App pair pin gains the two module-first cases (the only shape where that `/layers` refusal is still this card's); the BASE notes record the re-measure.

## Accepted deviation: pins of #32183 flipped

Epic note 6820163174 asks this card to flip #32183's pins of location 1 when it lands:

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (`e9e2227e`): `?package=ENABLED.custom` beside a package-less row with the other holder disabled was pinned 404 when the disabled holder registered first; it is the row in both orders now.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` (in the resolution of merge `bb1ab33d`): the CONTROL "the enabled holder's pair serves its item" ran in the enabled-first order only; it runs in both orders now.
